role: Detect and record conflicts between semantic edges in the knowledge graph before writing them.
detail: SemanticContradictionDetector class detects three patterns of semantic contradictions: (A) IS_A cycle violations (asymmetry), (B) CAUSES cycle violations (asymmetry), (C) HAS_PROPERTY vs LACKS_PROPERTY negation conflicts. On conflict detection, the existing edge's confidence is halved (×0.5), marked with has_conflict=True, conflict_type, contradiction_severity, and conflicting_proposed_edge_id fields. Severity is classified per Piaget equilibration theory (ALPHA=local correction, BETA=partial restructuring at 5+ edges, GAMMA=fundamental violation at 15+ edges). The proposed edge is never written; conflicts are returned to the caller (SemanticTeachingHandler) for arbitration. LogicalAxiom graph nodes are consulted at runtime to discover asymmetric edge types, making detection extensible. Constants: BETA_SEVERITY_EDGE_THRESHOLD=5, GAMMA_SEVERITY_EDGE_THRESHOLD=15. Key async methods: check_and_record(), _check_asymmetry_cycle(), _check_property_negation(), _classify_contradiction_severity(). Module helpers generate proposed edge IDs and natural-language summaries for guardian arbitration.
gotchas: Phase 1.8 (P1.8-E2/T006); transitive cycle detection deferred to E3/E4 (only direct one-hop cycles checked); relies on LogicalAxiom bootstrap completion, falls back to IS_A and CAUSES if axiom nodes absent; proposed edges never written to graph (deterministic IDs only for cross-linking); severity classification defaults to ALPHA on query failure; event publishing is non-fatal
